readme:
# GPTQ Cholesky 误差补偿量化

## 1. 问题

按固定列顺序量化权重，并用逆Hessian的Cholesky因子补偿剩余列误差。

给定上三角Cholesky因子的单块GPTQ核心；量化网格固定，Hessian估计、阻尼与分解由题外提供。

原文: [GPTQ: Accurate Post-Training Quantization for Generative Pre-trained Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.17323) · Section 4, Algorithm 1; official gptq.py fasterquant inner column loop.

## 2. 核心公式

$$
H^{-1}=U^TU,\qquad q_j=\Delta\,\operatorname{clip}(\operatorname{round}(w_j/\Delta),q_{min},q_{max}),\qquad e_j=(w_j-q_j)/U_{jj},\qquad W_{:,j:}\leftarrow W_{:,j:}-e_jU_{j,j:}.
$$

## 3. 公式到代码

- `gptq_quantize(weight: Tensor, upper: Tensor, scales: Tensor, qmin: int = -7, qmax: int = 7) -> Tensor` — Dequantized weights after sequential second-order error compensation.

拷贝工作权重，每列先保存网格化结果，再用归一化残差更新剩余权重。必须除以Cholesky对角而不是Hessian对角；补偿符号是减法。

## 4. 本题约定

weight:(O,D)，upper:(D,D)，scales:(O,)；upper严格上三角以下为零、对角>0，表示H^{-1}=U^T U。round为ties-to-even，整数界闭区间。从左到右量化，补偿包含当前列与所有后列。返回反量化float权重，不修改输入；离线PTQ不传梯度。

## 5. 交互图

使用两维相关校准输入和两行权重，扫描固定网格间距；比较GPTQ与独立逐元素round-to-nearest的输出重建MSE。

T3 使用实际待测函数生成实验，网页参考图使用参考实现。数值来自教学样本，不表示GPU吞吐或完整模型质量。

## 6. 在网页中运行

在右侧 Python 编辑器中补全实现，点击 **运行测试**。查看失败测试的原因、期望值与实际值，修改代码后再次运行。所有必要测试通过后，题目会标记为已完成并解锁坑点讲解。

## 7. 延伸

结合所引章节，解释本题保留了哪些维度、状态或调度约束，再扩展实验样本并保持已有契约。更大模型、真实设备与通信代价需要单独测量。

en.readme:
# GPTQ Cholesky Error-Compensated Quantization

## 1. Problem

Quantize columns in fixed order and compensate remaining columns using the inverse-Hessian Cholesky factor.

The single-block GPTQ core with a supplied upper Cholesky factor and fixed quantization grid; Hessian estimation, damping and factorization are supplied externally.

Source: [GPTQ: Accurate Post-Training Quantization for Generative Pre-trained Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.17323) · Section 4, Algorithm 1; official gptq.py fasterquant inner column loop.

## 2. Core equations

$$
H^{-1}=U^TU,\qquad q_j=\Delta\,\operatorname{clip}(\operatorname{round}(w_j/\Delta),q_{min},q_{max}),\qquad e_j=(w_j-q_j)/U_{jj},\qquad W_{:,j:}\leftarrow W_{:,j:}-e_jU_{j,j:}.
$$

## 3. From equations to code

- `gptq_quantize(weight: Tensor, upper: Tensor, scales: Tensor, qmin: int = -7, qmax: int = 7) -> Tensor` — Dequantized weights after sequential second-order error compensation.

Clone working weights, save each quantized column, then update the remaining columns with the normalized residual. Divide by the Cholesky diagonal, not the Hessian diagonal; subtract the correction.

## 4. Conventions

weight:(O,D), upper:(D,D), scales:(O,). upper has zeros below its positive diagonal and represents H^{-1}=U^T U. Use ties-to-even rounding and inclusive integer bounds. Quantize left to right and compensate the current and all later columns. Return dequantized floating weights without mutating inputs; offline PTQ has no gradients.

## 5. Experiment view

Use two correlated calibration features and two weight rows, sweep fixed quantization steps, and compare output-reconstruction MSE against independent round-to-nearest.

The chart is generated by the actual submitted kernel during T3 and by the reference during export. Values are synthetic teaching measurements, not GPU throughput or full-model quality claims.

## 6. Run your implementation

Complete the functions in the Python editor on the right, then click **Run tests**. Inspect each failed check, update your implementation, and run again. Passing every required check marks the problem as solved and unlocks the notes.

## 7. Further study

Read the cited section and explain which dimensions or scheduling constraints the kernel preserves. Then extend the experiment beyond the stated fixture while retaining the existing contract. Larger models, real devices, and communication costs require separate measurement.
en.notes:
# GPTQ Cholesky Error-Compensated Quantization — Solution notes

## Derivation and implementation

Clone working weights, save each quantized column, then update the remaining columns with the normalized residual. Divide by the Cholesky diagonal, not the Hessian diagonal; subtract the correction.

$$
H^{-1}=U^TU,\qquad q_j=\Delta\,\operatorname{clip}(\operatorname{round}(w_j/\Delta),q_{min},q_{max}),\qquad e_j=(w_j-q_j)/U_{jj},\qquad W_{:,j:}\leftarrow W_{:,j:}-e_jU_{j,j:}.
$$

## Boundary and gradient ownership

weight:(O,D), upper:(D,D), scales:(O,). upper has zeros below its positive diagonal and represents H^{-1}=U^T U. Use ties-to-even rounding and inclusive integer bounds. Quantize left to right and compensate the current and all later columns. Return dequantized floating weights without mutating inputs; offline PTQ has no gradients.

## Independent checks

T0 checks the callable contract and invalid boundaries. T1 uses hand calculations or an independent scalar formulation. T2 checks invariances, state conservation, gradients when meaningful, or atomic state changes. T3 invokes the supplied implementation in the deterministic experiment; it does not compare two imports of the same reference.

## Behavioral experiment

Use two correlated calibration features and two weight rows, sweep fixed quantization steps, and compare output-reconstruction MSE against independent round-to-nearest.

The single-block GPTQ core with a supplied upper Cholesky factor and fixed quantization grid; Hessian estimation, damping and factorization are supplied externally.

### Reference calibration

Deterministic CPU fixture; Python 3.14.2, PyTorch 2.14.1.

| Metric | Reference value |
| --- | ---: |
| compensated_mse | 0.09065 |
| rtn_mse | 0.28265 |

## Common mistakes

- m1_no_compensation: Independent rounding ignores correlated calibration channels.
- m2_wrong_error_sign: Adding quantization residuals amplifies instead of compensating error.
